rows.grounds: locative absolute expressing the condition upon attainment; referent supplied by prior context
compound specifying the substance to be consumed

items.question: What substance must be consumed once the desired result has been attained?
premises: A desired result has been attained (prāpte).
The prescribed substance is ghee from a brown cow (kapilāghṛtam).
The ritual instruction commands drinking this substance (palantu).
items.inference: Upon attainment of the desired result, one must drink ghee from a brown cow.
uncertainties: The specific result or attainment referred to by prāpte depends on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: When the desired result is obtained, they should drink ghee from a brown cow.
